# lanka

> A layered React application framework: gateways for transport, ViewModels for
> what a screen holds, scenarios for what happens between screens. Imports go one
> way and a lint rule says so. Core version 1.2.0; 27 packages,
> versioned independently — each document names the version it describes.

Install the core with `npm install lanka react zustand` — `react` and `zustand`
are peer dependencies, and only npm adds a missing peer for you. Everything
else is optional and installed one package at a time.

Every document below is flat markdown at a stable path, and the paths are
predictable: `<package>/GUIDE.md` to use a package, `<package>/README.md` for
what it is, `<package>/SKILL.md` for what may not change, `api/<name>.api.md`
for exactly what it publishes. The examples under `_playground/` are compiled and
run in CI, so code cited from them is code that works against this version.

## Start here

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/README.md): the nineteen packages and what each is for
- [core/GUIDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/core/GUIDE.md): the framework in one guide — start-up, the four layers, a screen end to end
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): how to structure an application, with what is CHECKED separated from what is advice
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): running the repository, and how a release is cut

### @lankajs/host

The two places lanka meets Next, React Router, TanStack Start or Expo: one instance per unit of server work, and one first state per screen.

## Tools

### @lankajs/tool-di

The `@lanka_di` alias, scaffolding for six barrels, and a contract check before the build starts — for six bundlers, or for one with no adapter at all.

- [tools/di/GUIDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/di/GUIDE.md): how to use it, with examples
- [tools/di/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/di/README.md): what it is and why it is shaped this way
- [tools/di/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/di/SKILL.md): what may not change in it
- [tools/di/_playground/app.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/di/_playground/app.ts): @lankajs/tool-di, working code
- [tools/di/_playground/playground.test.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/di/_playground/playground.test.ts): @lankajs/tool-di, working code

### @lankajs/tool-eslint

The framework's main promise — imports go one way — is checked by the framework, not by its consumers.

- [tools/eslint/GUIDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/eslint/GUIDE.md): how to use it, with examples
- [tools/eslint/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/eslint/README.md): what it is and why it is shaped this way
- [tools/eslint/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/eslint/SKILL.md): what may not change in it
- [tools/eslint/_playground/app.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/eslint/_playground/app.ts): @lankajs/tool-eslint, working code
- [tools/eslint/_playground/playground.test.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/eslint/_playground/playground.test.ts): @lankajs/tool-eslint, working code

### @lankajs/tool-testing

The only package allowed into core's internals, and therefore the one that justifies sealing them.

- [tools/testing/GUIDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/testing/GUIDE.md): how to use it, with examples
- [tools/testing/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/testing/README.md): what it is and why it is shaped this way

- [tools/testing/_playground/playground.test.tsx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/testing/_playground/playground.test.tsx): @lankajs/tool-testing, working code

### @lankajs/tool-skills

Puts each installed package's agent skill into the project, at the version actually installed.

- [tools/skills/GUIDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lankajs/lanka/refs/heads/main/tools/skills/GUIDE.md): how to use it, with examples

## The rules this repository holds itself to

Written for whoever changes the framework, and readable by anyone deciding
whether its opinions match theirs.
